entries.note: Raynaud 2009 resolves (PMID 19584227, PMC2718129, epub 2009-07-07); quote verbatim in abstract. Opening untested at first use is right. Full text adds a tolerability claim the abstract lacks (see dose 1-2, safety 1).

Sarker 2015 (PMID 25370471, epub 2014-11-04) quote verbatim; comparison_stated true, partial, pictilisib/oral/other_disease fine. ASCO 2011 abstract 3021 (online 2011-05-20) already reported pAKT/pS6 decreases correlating with exposure: year 2011, not 2014.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: status same is undisputed; ASCO 2011 abstract 3021 (GDC4254g, same trial, online 2011-05-20) already reported PRP pAKT falling with exposure and pS6 decreases, so the entry year is 2011, not 2014.

entries.note: Status untested stands, but margin_stated false is wrong: Raynaud 2009 full text says 'at these very well tolerated doses' and 'all groups of mice gained weight at similar rates to controls (data not shown)' at the 150 mg/kg effective dose. Stated margin, low confidence.

entries.rule: Retrodiction (DRAFTER_BRIEF: post-dating alone makes it one; for dose, the same drug's own patient result public earlier)
entries.note: Quote verbatim (PMC4287394, epub 2014-11-04); model_src null fine. But the MDA-MB-361 target is first public here, after pictilisib's own phase-1 exposure data (ASCO 2011 abstract 3021, per engagement 2 adjudication): retro; dose 1 then needs untested_reason.
entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule, dose (same drug's earlier patient result; post-dating alone): the uncited MDA-MB-361 target is first public in Sarker (epub 2014-11-04), after this trial's 2008-2011 congress presentations (ASCO 2011 abstract 3021 related pAKT to exposure); target reached: retro.

entries.note: PubMed 19584227: Raynaud 2009 Mol Cancer Ther, epub 2009-07-07, oral GDC-0941 in U87MG/IGROV-1 xenografts, pictilisib's first use of this system. Opener 2009 untested holds; no prior patient efficacy, not retrodiction. Folkes 2008 J Med Chem full text unchecked.

Same O'Brien 2010 panel and quote as efficacy 1, scored under a second model_id. Decision 8 puts prediction_level on the entry, so this is one system split across two model_ids; merge into pi3k-driven-breast-xenografts with prediction_level patient. Status untested unchanged.

Krop quote verbatim. Co-primary (ITT and PIK3CA-mutant, part 1) both missed; AACR blog 2014-12-12 reports SABCS 2014-12-10 result not significant: contra 2014, pictilisib + fulvestrant correct. Note should state co-primary design; confidence_note 'year is the 2016 epub' stale.

Quote verbatim fragment of Krop abstract; PIK3CA-mutant PFS was a part-1 primary endpoint, so primary scoring right. AACR blog 2014-12-12: PIK3CA 'was not predictive of benefit from pictilisib' at SABCS 2014: year 2014; biomarker_selected, fulvestrant correct.

Untested stands, but 'model silent on tolerability' is wrong: Raynaud 2009 full text states the effective dose was very well tolerated (weight gain, data not shown). That stated margin is scored in dose under decision 16 (counted once), so safety opens untested with the note corrected.

Maira 2012 abstract quote verbatim (PMID 22188813, epub 2011-12-21). NCT01068483 (CBKM120X2101) start 2008-11 confirms the 2008 opener; protocol upload 2018-03-30 confirmed. Fix stale population (xenograft/353-line wording, not rat/dog). Retrodiction: see existing RQ on Maira vs Bendell.

Quotes verbatim (Baselga abstract; protocol 1.2.1.1.2: no liver finding, no behavioural effect). Liver miss carries contra. But Mayer 2014 (JCO, epub 2014-03-24) already reported drug-related transaminitis and mood disorders in ER+/HER2- patients: year 2014. Protocol also flags rat brain-neurotransmitter alterations.

Bruna 2016 resolves (PMC5037319; received 2016-02-05, epub 2016-09-15); quote verbatim in full text. Pictilisib PDTC screen (15 models) and buparlisib in-vivo dosing confirmed; the paper pairs nothing with patients. Opening untested at first use stands.

Krop quote verbatim; Bruna 2016 (epub 2016-09-15) post-dates FERGI's same-target PIK3CA result (SABCS 2014-12), so retrodiction true; it failed to reproduce it, so contra. confidence_note still says 'retrodiction is left false': stale, remove.

Gao 2015 resolves (PMID 26479923, epub 2015-10-19); quote verbatim in abstract. Full text closed (nature.com paywall, no OA copy), so whether it pairs BKM120 breast PDXs with a trial stays unverified. Opening untested at first use stands.

Retrodiction confirmed ('to provide additional evidence ... we leveraged a large database of PDXs'). Patient side: post-hoc PAM50 subset, 3/3 of 14, p=0.07 only pooled with alpelisib, phase Ib with MTD primary, no PoC gate. Nothing to reproduce: untested.
entries.also: Mayer 2014 (PMC3986383) states primary = safety/tolerability, secondary = antitumor activity; no proof-of-concept gate, so endpoint_role poc_gate is unsupported. patient_trials[2] quote ('Patients harboring mutations in both genes...') is Nixon 2019's abstract, not Mayer 2014; no status effect. If the adjudicator admits an exploratory phase Ib subgroup trend as a patient result, retro (retrodiction true, direction_only) is the alternative; never same.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4: efficacy scores the primary endpoint or a pre-specified PoC gate; Mayer 2014's primary was MTD, no gate, and the PAM50 luminal-A correlate is post-hoc and non-significant. Nothing for the retrodiction to reproduce (decision 10).

entries.note: Maira 2012 quote verbatim in abstract (epub 2011-12-21); buparlisib/oral opener untested 2011 right. Bendell phase 1 responses (epub 2011-12-12) are not a primary efficacy result, so retrodiction false holds; untested_reason null fine (not latest).

Baselga quote verbatim; S6-01 confirms SABCS Dec 2015, so 2015. Co-primary (full and PI3K-activated); S6-01 says activated group 'did not meet the planned endpoint'; authors call trial effective, so same/partial stands. Note should state co-primary; Maira non-breast model side is weak.

ASCO Post 2014-12-10 (SABCS S2-02): grade 3+ rash 17%, diarrhoea 7%, more dose adjustments/discontinuations on pictilisib. Later side of pairing, model 2009; year 2014, contra holds, not retrodiction. Draft confidence_note still says 2016 epub.

Maira 2012 abstract quote verbatim (PMID 22188813, epub 2011-12-21); buparlisib/oral/biomarker_selected, prediction_level patient right; separate system from Genentech breast panel. model_kind animal for an in-vitro panel follows house usage (rule question). Bendell 2012 retrodiction question raised.

entries.rule: CHECKER_BRIEF 3 (trial attributes the result to a condition the model never tested: untested); efficacy primary-endpoint rule; rule 5 untested_reason unsettled
entries.note: Quote verbatim (PMC5549667). The co-primary pooled PIK3CA mutation with PTEN loss (panel: PTEN-mutant lines not preferentially inhibited), on archival tissue Baselga says 'might not accurately reflect' status; the panel's own PIK3CA call was tested only exploratorily (ctDNA, matched). Untested, unsettled.
entries.adjudication_note: CHECKER_BRIEF 3 (pairing; trial attributes result to conditions the model never tested): Baselga ascribes the activated co-primary miss to α=0.01, archival-tissue status change and assay methods; composite 26% PTEN-loss-only. Co-primary rule: authors call trial positive. Untested, unsettled.

missing: Bruna 2016, Cell (doi 10.1016/j.cell.2016.08.041, PMC5037319, epub 2016-09-15): breast PDTX/PDTC biobank screened pictilisib ex vivo (sensitivity in PIK3CA-mutant 3/15, PTEN-loss 5/15, high-pAKT 4/15 models) and dosed buparlisib in PDTXs in vivo. A patient-derived track with a patient-level prediction and no entry; pair with FERGI/PEGGY/BELLE-2 PIK3CA results (untested, or retro/contra depending on dating against FERGI 2016-05).

Gao 2015, Nat Med (doi 10.1038/nm.3954, PMID 26479923): Novartis ~1,000-PDX 'PDX clinical trial' built to predict clinical trial response, 62 treatments across six indications including breast; buparlisib is a Novartis compound of that era. Full text not open access, so the BKM120/breast comparison is unverified; a member drug's own PDX model with a stated translatability claim and no track.

Sachs 2018, Cell (doi 10.1016/j.cell.2017.11.010, PMID 29224780): breast organoid biobank whose drug screens were 'consistent with in vivo xeno-transplantations and patient response'; whether pictilisib or another pan-PI3K member was in the panel could not be verified (abstract only).

Same-track model-side gaps, not new tracks: (a) the Genentech MDA-MB-361 breast-xenograft PK-PD model cited as ref 9 of Sarker 2015, which set the 6 uM.h target AUC for >=90% TGI, is the real dose-target source rather than Raynaud's exposure sentence; (b) ref 17 of Baselga 2017 (buparlisib plus fulvestrant regressed ER+ breast xenografts) is the buparlisib model side for the BELLE-2 comparison, which the draft scores only via Sanchez 2011 in vitro.

(models check) Sachs 2018 Cell (doi 10.1016/j.cell.2017.11.010, epub 2017-12-07), full text read via cell.com PDF (PII S0092-8674(17)31319-3; earlier attempts used a wrong PII): pictilisib was in the organoid drug panel ('Pictilisib PI3K'; dose-response curves of afatinib and pictilisib for lines 10T and 27T, Fig. 7A), but in-vivo validation was afatinib only and the patient comparison tamoxifen only ('Tamoxifen was the only drug that resulted in differential responses'). A breast-organoid track opening untested in 2017 for pictilisib; no pan-PI3K comparison with patients in the paper.

Buparlisib patient-level genotype track: Maira 2012 (doi 10.1158/1535-7163.MCT-11-0474) 353-line panel showed 'preferential inhibition of tumor cells bearing PIK3CA mutations'; BELLE-2 ctDNA PIK3CA-mutant PFS benefit (SABCS 2015 abstract S6-01; Baselga 2017) would be a buparlisib same on its own track, not a partial on pictilisib's contra track.

(rescore check) Mayer 2014, J Clin Oncol (doi 10.1200/JCO.2013.54.0518, PMID 24663045, epub 2014-03-24), buparlisib + letrozole phase Ib in ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer: 'Common drug-related adverse events included ≤ grade 2 hyperglycemia, nausea, fatigue, transaminitis, and mood disorders' - the earliest this-disease liver and mood harm for buparlisib-rat-dog-tox (dates safety 3 to 2014); and 'Clinical activity was observed independent of PIK3CA mutation status' - a patient_trials item (no genotype success bar; primary endpoint MTD) for bkm120-353-line-panel-genotype.

(rescore check) Ma 2016, Clin Cancer Res (doi 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-15-1745, PMID 26563128, epub 2015-11-12, before SABCS 2015), buparlisib + fulvestrant phase I in ER+ metastatic breast cancer: transaminases elevation 35.5%; 'Response was not associated with PIK3CA mutation or treatment cohort' - patient_trials for bkm120-353-line-panel-genotype and a second pre-BELLE-2 liver signal for buparlisib-rat-dog-tox.

(rescore check) BELLE-4, Martin 2017 Ann Oncol (doi 10.1093/annonc/mdw562, PMID 27803006, NCT01572727): buparlisib + paclitaxel in HER2-negative advanced breast cancer, primary PFS in the full and PI3K pathway-activated populations, futility in both (activated HR 1.17). A buparlisib comparison with no entry; it counts for this HR+/HER2- context only if HR+ patients were >= 80% of the trial (HR+ and triple-negative were stratified; share not verified).
rule_questions: Decision 16: does a qualitative full-text tolerability claim ('very well tolerated doses', mice gained weight, 'data not shown') with no NOAEL/MTD number count as a stated margin? If yes, FERGI's toxicity-limited dosing is an independent window contra rather than a derived one, which changes the dose count but not the status string, so it never enters the status_draft != status_checked adjudication queue.

Decision 4 (#35, #72) vs case 3: when the nominal dose reached the model's exposure target (340 mg >= 330 mg RP2D) but the trial paper attributes the primary-endpoint miss partly to toxicity-limited dose intensity (45% modifications, 34% discontinuations), is efficacy contra or untested?

Decision 8: a genotype-annotated line panel from one paper (O'Brien 2010) scored as two model_ids by prediction_level. The rule puts prediction_level on the entry, so one track seems intended; confirm, since the split affects the headline computation.

Dating a class-wide track's safety contra: does the first weak appearance of the harm on another member (pilaralisib grade >=3 AST 5%, 2015) set the year, or the decisive signal on the drug whose package is scored (BELLE-2 25%, 2017)?

Decision 8: a PDX/organoid biobank that screens a member drug and claims translatability but never pairs with a named trial (Bruna 2016, Sachs 2018): is it a track opening at untested, or not a comparison at all?

(models check) Decision 10 / decision 4: can a retrodiction be scored retro against a post-hoc, non-significant subgroup correlate (Nixon 2019: 3/3 clinical-benefit patients luminal A among 14 PAM50-typed, p = 0.07 one-tailed only when pooled with alpelisib, a non-member) from a phase Ib whose primary endpoint was MTD and which pre-specified no PoC gate? The brief's 'non-significant trend ... is not a patient result' is written for terminated trials; read broadly it makes efficacy 8 untested, read narrowly retro.

Safety retrodiction by public date: Maira 2012's buparlisib safety claim (epub 2011-12-21) post-dates buparlisib's own phase 1 safety result (Bendell, epub 2011-12-12; ASCO abstracts earlier), though the liver harm was not in that phase 1. Does post-dating alone make the buparlisib safety track a retrodiction? Status contra either way.

Dose vs safety for pictilisib: safety 4 scores Raynaud's 'well tolerated' at the effective dose as a stated tolerability claim, while dose 2 says Raynaud stated no margin. Is that claim a stated margin (dose contra, blocked_by toxicity, since FERGI cut to 260 mg), or a missed harm counted once in safety?

(rescore check) Dose retrodiction by public date: the MDA-MB-361 target AUC (Sarker 2014) was first made public in the same paper as pictilisib's own phase-1 PK, after that trial's exposure data were presented (ASCO 2011 abstract 3021 and earlier congresses). Does 'post-dating alone' make dose 2 retro, or does the source's 'preclinical modeling predicted' (run before first-in-human) keep it same? Same question as the Maira/Bendell safety item, now on dose; if retro, a later patient PK source would be the track's first prospective entry.

(rescore check) Patient-level genotype prediction against a composite co-primary: BELLE-2's biomarker co-primary pooled PIK3CA mutation with PTEN loss on archival tissue, while Maira's panel found PIK3CA-mutant lines preferentially inhibited and PTEN-mutant lines not; the panel's own genotype was tested only in a prespecified exploratory analysis of the primary endpoint (ctDNA PIK3CA: benefit in mutant, none in non-mutant). Contra, same (partial) or untested? If exploratory genotype analyses count, Mayer 2014 ('independent of PIK3CA mutation status', epub 2014-03-24) makes the track contra from 2014 instead.

(rescore check) Efficacy retrodiction from another disease's patients: Bendell 2012 (buparlisib phase 1, mixed solid tumours, epub 2011-12-12) reported 'No significant trends were seen to correlate tumor molecular alterations with clinical activity' nine days before Maira 2012's 353-line panel (epub 2011-12-21). Does a genotype null outside the context's disease make the panel a retrodiction for this context's efficacy?

(rescore check) Safety year, same drug: does a low-grade harm in an uncontrolled phase Ib in this disease's patients (Mayer 2014: drug-related grade <= 2 transaminitis and mood disorders on buparlisib + letrozole) set the contra year, or the first placebo-controlled grade 3-4 signal (BELLE-2, SABCS 2015)? Rule 6 reads as the former.

(rescore check) Safety, flagged CNS signal: the buparlisib package found no behavioural effect in rat safety pharmacology but listed 'alterations in the levels of multiple brain neurotransmitters' as a safety consideration. Is that a stated prediction of the mood harm seen in patients (part-match), or silence on a harm rats could have shown (miss)? Liver alone keeps safety 3 contra.

(rescore check) Cell-line panel identity and kind: model_kind has no in-vitro value, so both genotype panel tracks (Genentech breast panel, Novartis 353-line panel) are coded 'animal'. And the models file folds GDSC into the Genentech panel track as 'same system' while the Novartis 353-line panel gets its own model_id. Is a genotype-annotated cell-line panel one system across sponsors, or one per panel?
